transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… my eating’s been pretty off lately. Some days before work I barely get down coffee and maybe a granola bar, and my scrubs are starting to hang loose. I’m not trying to lose weight, so… that’s part of why I came in.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
No… not really. I’m not trying to lose weight or anything. I just haven’t been eating much—some mornings it’s coffee and maybe a granola bar before my shift, and my scrubs are getting loose.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Yeah… most mornings, I guess. I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling, like the day’s already ruined before I even get my badge on.
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time your eating started to change?
Yeah… around when the clinic changed the EMR and all the workflow stuff. My hours got different after that. It’s been… almost two years now, I guess.
When you’re away from work for a few days, do you still wake up with that heavy, hollow feeling?
Yeah… even when I’m off for a few days, most mornings it’s still there. That heavy, hollow feeling, like the day’s already kind of ruined.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess I have. I used to run in Van Cortlandt, take pictures, play chess with a couple friends. Lately I just… don’t see the point. I end up at home scrolling or checking my budget spreadsheet instead.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I… yeah, sometimes. I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself or anything like that. It’s more like… I catch myself wishing I just wouldn’t wake up, or that it’d be easier if I could just disappear.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah… at work especially. Someone will ask me something simple, like an intake question, and I’ll start answering about the EMR screen, then somehow I’m talking about staffing numbers or something I read for licensure. Then I see their face and realize I didn’t really answer what they asked.
For at least two weeks, have you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Yeah… most days. It’s like I wake up already feeling heavy, hollow… like the day’s ruined before I even get my badge on.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things, even when there isn’t an immediate problem to deal with?
I don’t know… not really in that way. I mean, I think about things, but I wouldn’t say I’m worrying all the time for no reason.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
Yeah. It’s… not great. I lie there going over work stuff, kind of listening for noises, and then I’m up around 3 or 4. After that I usually can’t really get back to sleep before the alarm.
Have other people noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Yeah… a couple people have said I seem slowed down sometimes. At work, answering patients or doing labels can take me longer than it should. Other times I’m kind of the opposite, pacing around the supply area and checking the same drawers again.
When you look at your body, do you feel fat or like you need to be thinner?
No… not really. I mean, I don’t love how I look sometimes, but I don’t feel like I need to be thinner or anything.
Do you still feel this depressed on days when work isn’t involved at all?
Yeah… it’s not just work. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, like the day’s already gone bad before I even get dressed.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot lately?

Yeah… I guess I have. I keep feeling like I’m just… in the way, like I’m a burden at the clinic and at home. If I mess up something small, like a room turnover taking too long, I blame myself like I ruined everyone’s whole day.
Have you lost your appetite lately?

Yeah… I have. I don’t really feel like eating much. Some days before work it’s just coffee and maybe a granola bar, and that’s kind of it. My scrubs have been feeling looser too, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
